overall_assessment: Reduced-sampling local Oracle: WT/A2 comparisons are computed from three independent velocity seeds of new LAMMPS trajectories; long-time convergence is not claimed.

outcomes.method: per-chain radius of gyration from unwrapped native coordinates
outcomes.uncertainty_method: 95% t interval across three independent velocity seeds
outcomes.decision_rule: effect resolved only when the A2-minus-WT interval excludes zero
outcomes.interpretation: difference in mean PD chain size between A2 and WT

outcomes.decision_rule: effect resolved only when the A2-minus-WT interval excludes zero
